description: Scenario-set coverage and diversity report (docs/design/scenario_set_and_ablation_design.md §7.3; docs/specs/scenario-set-coverage.md; src/scenariogen/coverage_runner.py). The book's principal loss directions come from each trade's daily full-revaluation P&L over the VaR lookback: as many as reach variance_share of the total variance, at most max_components. Coverage is the variance-weighted share of those directions spanned by the scenarios' per-trade P&L at the tier; a direction spanned less than uncovered_below is flagged uncovered. Diversity is the loss-weighted participation ratio of the scenarios after removing the book's first direction, against diversity_target; pairs above merge_threshold cosine on those beta-removed vectors are merge candidates (§4.2 merge rule, applied by hand).
